export: NHDOT GIS crash layer export (crashes from NH DMV VISION, located on NHDOT's LRS), by request to NHDOT Bureau of Planning (GISMaps@dot.nh.gov) or NHDOT's crash data analyst
spec: No public column list. Layout seen live (2026-11-08) in two re-hosts of NHDOT's layer: NHDOT_Crash_Data_RT114 (newer, 2017-2023) https://services8.arcgis.com/M2LuFXYoyXAAOrnN/arcgis/rest/services/NHDOT_Crash_Data_RT114/FeatureServer/0 and UVLSRPC Crash History (older, 2002-2017) https://services1.arcgis.com/Lxx6ZzbB9K8v0kCg/arcgis/rest/services/Crash_History/FeatureServer/0. Names below are the newer layout's, with the older in brackets. Confirm on one sample.
unit: one row per crash; person/vehicle tables not seen

map.datetime: CRASHDATE (epoch ms, local midnight) + CRASHTIME (hhmm, e.g. 727 = 07:27) [CRASH_DATE + ACDTIME]
map.lat: DECIMALLATITUDE (officer GPS, text) else DOT_LATITUDE (NHDOT's located point) [layer geometry]
map.primary_road: ROUTENO_STREETNAME: a class digit, spaces, then the road ('0  114 RTE', '1  NEW BOSTON RD'); strip the leading digit [ACDSTREET, often with a house number: '2345 RT 25A'; route code in ACDROUTE '00118']
map.secondary_road: FIRSTNODE*/SECONDNODE* node ids (no cross-street text in the newer layout) [INTERSTREE + INTERROUTE]
map.sec_distance: FEET from FROMMILEMARKER / DISTANCEFIRSTNODETOSECOND [MILESFTFRO, read as feet]
map.route_milepoint: SRI (e.g. S0000114__ = state route 114) + MP_ACCIDENT (miles): joins to HIGHWAYS_LRS_ROUTES in NHDOT's GIS snapshot
map.severity: SEVERITY: Fatal Injury=K, Suspected Serious Injury=A, Suspected Minor Injury=B, Possible Injury=C, No Apparent Injury=O, Unknown=U [Killed=K, Incapacitating=A, Non_Incapacitating=B, Possible=C, No Apparent Injury=O, Unknown=U]
map.reportable: REPORTABLE Yes/No: keep Yes only (22 of 1,000 RT114 rows are No)
